summary: This is a prospectus supplement (424B5) for a follow-on equity offering by VIAVI SOLUTIONS INC. The registrant is offering 11,111,111 shares of common stock at $45.00 per share, representing a ~9.5% discount to the closing price of $49.75, for expected gross proceeds of $500 million. Underwriters have a 30-day option for 1,666,666 additional shares. The offering is an ordinary shelf takedown under an automatic shelf registration statement by a well-known seasoned issuer. This is a routine capital markets transaction, not a special situation event.
